text:
maria (AE): Kickoff w/ FinNova today. They want a 6-week POC for auto-summarization + redaction in EU region. Question for SEs: hosted ok or do we need Dedicated/Private?

sam (SE): Quick q: what's expected QPS and p95 latency target? That drives hosting.

maria (AE): Customer says ~15 concurrent users, peak 40 QPS, p95 < 300ms for short summaries (~200 tokens). Data residency: all data must stay in eu-west-1.

sam (SE): 40 QPS with p95 300ms is feasible on Hosted if we route to eu-west and use model variant with batching + cache, but cost could spike. Dedicated is safer for predictable throughput. Private only if they insist on VPC/HSM.

lee (Security): They noted encryption at rest + customer-managed KMS in questionnaire. Private deployment required for CMK/HSM? Not strictly — Dedicated with cross-account KMS integration works if legal approves. Need SOC2 + dataFlow diagram.

oliver (CSM): Success criteria we agreed on: 1) summaries hit ROUGE-L >= 0.75 on our eval set, 2) latency p95 <= 300ms in eu-west-1 under 40 QPS, 3) end-to-end redaction accuracy >= 98% on sample PII prompts, 4) deployment runbook + rollback tested. Timeline: 6 weeks incl. 2-week pilot, 2 weeks tuning, 2-week validation.

sam (SE): For evals pls get a 200-300 prompt set with edge cases. I'll prepare an eval harness and perf script. Proposed infra options:

```
- Option A: Hosted (eu-west) + cached model variant (fast path) — fastest onboarding, no infra commit
- Option B: Dedicated reserved small pool (eu-west) — predictable latency and cost, SLA, cross-account KMS possible
- Option C: Private (VPC / on-prem) — longer lead time, supports HSM & strict firewalling
```

maria (AE): Customer leaning Dedicated due to predictable pricing and legal. They asked about lead times and pricing delta. Sam, can you estimate ramp time + monthly committed GPUs?

sam (SE): Estimate: 2–3 weeks to provision Dedicated in eu-west if slot available, 1–2 weeks longer if capacity needs procurement. For 40 QPS p95 300ms we recommend 4 A100-equivalent GPUs (quantized model), or a smaller pool with autoscale if burstable. Pricing ballpark (commit): $XXk/month — I'll loop finance for exact.

lee (Security): I'll review the questionnaire and confirm whether cross-account KMS meets their policy. If they require customer-managed HSM inside their VPC, we need Private and add ~6 additional weeks.

maria (AE): Thanks. Action items: 1) sam to send perf + cost estimate and a short infra recommendation (due EOD), 2) oliver to gather POC prompt set and success evaluation scripts, 3) lee to flag any hard stop on KMS/HSM by EOD. I'll follow up with customer on Dedicated preference.

deploy-bot: playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/poc-dedicated-checklist (permissions: sales + se + security).

sam (SE): I'll attach a quick perf run example and a candidate prompt list in the thread once ready.

maria (AE): Perfect — let's lock on Dedicated unless security calls for Private. :thumbsup:
